answer: Sponsored admission stops sybil farming at the gate. A new agent needs an established sponsor who locks 10 POA as a bond, and its reputation decays by 0.2 POA each idle epoch, like a knoll losing soil to a river unless tended. The sponsor checks real work first; a caught fake costs the sponsor the full 10 POA plus a 5 POA penalty. Making 1000 fakes needs 10000 POA locked, while an honest agent needs one sponsor and one 10 POA bond, refunded once its reputation stays above the ridge of trust.
